proposed_capability: MoonWake /sixth-gear P141→P95→P82→P08→P07→P124 scoped to BetterInstincts local Codex prematurely ending an authorized gameplay session when The Sims 4 is merely paused or an interim P08 report was emitted. Admit a bounded, read-only, no-agent-loop decision seam to keep the parent goal open and classify safe next work without granting game inputs, save writes or OS effects.
player_save_control_impact: Does not click, unpause, save, delete, reload, scan input, alter Windows controls or change game/host settings. Player activity, unknown scene, save uncertainty and per-effect permit always guard screen work. A previously authorized request to play is not itself a fresh effect permit. No hidden background scheduler, no per-frame polling, no persistent telemetry.
expected_outcome: Pure input-to-decision seam plus local CLI and negative tests: paused game is not goal completion; interim P08 block is not whole sixth-gear termination; continue source/analysis or prepare fresh host effect admission when permitted; preserve player takeover; stop only on evidenced completion or precisely identified unavailable required gate with no other actionable work.
negative_tests: Paused live game with explicit operator play permission and no verified completion may not end the parent run
A report saying played thirteen minutes must not count as parent completion
No local P08 game effect evidence must not block all offline repo work
Active or unknown player presence must never authorize unpause or keyboard/mouse effects
Unknown save, game scene or unverified session denies effects but leaves safe read-only work available
Source evidence missing cannot convert an agent assertion into a terminal blocker
True completion requires nonempty acceptance evidence, not an arbitrary elapsed-time threshold
No standalone agent sleep loop, daemon, repeated blind clicks or user-save mutation
rollback_path: Revert the isolated pure-advisory code/contract/tests/docs PR; no game or host state touched.
unresolved_unknowns: The screenshot is a single frozen frame and does not prove current foreground, live scene, save class, Sims build or user activity at future action time
Codex UI does not expose an assured pre-stop hook through this connected GitHub tool; local agent must invoke CLI by instruction or a separately certified host adapter
Actual local Windows game effects, game state and BI-002 5+5 hunger trials require host runtime
MoonWake PR #372 separately owns scoped launcher transport and is not merged as of initial inspection
decision_rationale: P141 compared stopping on elapsed time (reject), treating all paused-game observations as a host block (reject), a new autonomous game controller (reject), and pure session-liveness assessment piggybacking existing human-first host authority (select). P95 designs typed evidence; P82 falsifies false terminals/player/saves; P08 remains local Windows-only; P07/P124 implement a pure CLI/contract/tests and owner-aligned handoff without forking MoonWake's generic execution boundary engine.
